url.ip_host.title: IP address used as hostname
url.ip_host.description: The URL uses an IP address as its hostname. This can be a contextual risk indicator but does not establish phishing.

url.at_authority.title: Obfuscated URL authority
url.at_authority.description: An at-sign was detected in the URL authority. It can obscure which host the URL actually addresses.

url.idn.title: Internationalized hostname encoding
url.idn.description: Punycode encoding was detected. Internationalized domains can be legitimate; visual similarity needs context.

url.typosquatting.title: Possible brand-like domain spelling
url.typosquatting.description: The existing URL analysis detected a spelling pattern similar to a known brand. Similarity alone does not prove impersonation.

url.lure_keywords.title: Sensitive-action words in URL
url.lure_keywords.description: The URL contains words associated with login or account actions. Such words also occur on legitimate sites.

url.entropy.title: High URL character variability
url.entropy.description: The URL has elevated character variability under the configured rule. Encoded or generated legitimate URLs may share this pattern.

url.length.title: Long URL
url.length.description: URL length exceeded the configured contextual threshold. Length alone does not establish malicious intent.

domain.young.title: Recently registered domain
domain.young.description: Available registration data indicates a recent registration. Domain age alone does not prove phishing.

negative.title: Longer domain registration history
negative.description: Available registration data exceeds the recent-registration risk window. A longer history does not guarantee safety.

dns.restricted.title: Restricted outbound destination
dns.restricted.description: DNS analysis marked the destination as unsuitable for public scanning. This is a connection safety restriction, not proof of phishing.

negative.title: Destination passed public-address checks
negative.description: Available DNS analysis passed public-address restrictions. This permits scanning and does not prove site legitimacy.

tls.invalid.title: TLS certificate not validated
tls.invalid.description: Available TLS analysis did not validate the certificate. Connection validation failures do not alone establish phishing.

negative.title: TLS certificate validated
negative.description: Available TLS analysis validated the certificate. HTTPS protects the connection but does not prove the site is legitimate.

reputation.provider.title: Reputation source raised an alert
reputation.provider.description: Available reputation intelligence reports an alert. Historical or unconfirmed matches can be inaccurate and require review.

negative.title: Provider reports no reputation alert
negative.description: Available provider evidence reports SAFE. This is the provider's observation, not a guarantee of safety or current behavior.

html.external_credentials.title: Credential form targets another domain
html.external_credentials.description: Static analysis found a password form targeting another registrable domain. Legitimate identity providers can use this pattern; review its context.

negative.title: No external credential form observed
negative.description: No password form targeting another registrable domain was observed in the analyzed static HTML. Dynamic or unobserved content can differ.

html.script_obfuscation.title: Script encoding or obfuscation pattern
html.script_obfuscation.description: Static script analysis detected an encoding or obfuscation pattern. Minified or legitimate scripts may also match.

html.external_iframe.title: External iframe reference
html.external_iframe.description: The static page references an iframe on another domain. External frames can be legitimate and were not executed.

content.urgency.title: Urgent-action language
content.urgency.description: Static content analysis detected urgent-action language. Wording alone does not establish phishing.

content.credentials.title: Credential-related language
content.credentials.description: Static content analysis detected credential-related wording. Legitimate login pages also use these words.

content.financial.title: Financial-action language
content.financial.description: Static content analysis detected financial-action wording. This is contextual evidence rather than proof of fraud.

brand.mismatch.title: Brand and domain mismatch
brand.mismatch.description: Brand claims and domain evidence differ. In Phase 9, this scored signal requires multiple page fields plus corroborating credential evidence; a title alone is insufficient.

negative.title: No configured brand mismatch observed
negative.description: The available static brand signal did not report a mismatch. It does not establish a verified brand identity.

ml.phishing.title: URL model risk estimate
ml.phishing.description: The URL-only model assigned a nonzero phishing probability. This model estimate is separate from the final assessment and is not proof of malicious behavior.

summary.PHISHING: The assessment reports phishing; review the supporting observations and limitations below.
summary.SUSPICIOUS: The assessment requires review; the available observations and limitations are listed below.
summary.LEGITIMATE: No strong phishing indicators met the current verdict policy. This is not a safety guarantee.
summary.UNKNOWN: The available evidence is insufficient for a definitive verdict.
summary.ANALYSIS_FAILED: The analysis failed; no safety conclusion is available.

messages.missing_description: The {name} observation is unavailable or incomplete. No safety conclusion was inferred from its absence.
messages.not_applicable: This observation is not applicable to the analyzed context.
messages.password_description: Static HTML analysis counted {count} password input field(s). Password fields also occur on legitimate login pages.
messages.ml_feature_description: Replacing this URL feature with its observed training median changed the model probability by {impact}. This measures model sensitivity, not causal attribution.
messages.ml_unavailable: Local model feature impacts are unavailable; none were inferred or fabricated.
messages.invalid: Some explanation inputs were invalid or unsupported and were omitted.
messages.size_limit: Additional explanation detail was omitted to respect the configured output limit.
messages.consistency: The assessment lacks matching strong explanation evidence; review the original assessment. No reason was invented.
messages.model_limit: Feature impacts are training-median perturbation sensitivities, not additive risk-score contributions, SHAP values or causal proof.
messages.confidence_limit: Assessment confidence is a provisional evidence-quality index, not a calibrated correctness probability.
messages.dynamic: Browser behavior was not executed; this analysis is static only.
messages.external: External page resources were not fetched or executed.
messages.floor: The configured corroboration rule raised the risk score floor. This adjustment is separate from individual signal contributions.
messages.behavior_adjustment: Phase 6 applied the strongest configured redirect-chain adjustment once, with a cap of 10 points. Ordinary cross-domain and HTTP-to-HTTPS transitions do not add points.

contradictions.ML_REPUTATION_CONFLICT: The URL model indicates elevated risk while a reliable reputation provider reports SAFE. This conflict reduces assessment confidence.
contradictions.ML_OBSERVED_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: A low URL model estimate conflicts with malicious reputation or corroborated static webpage findings. This conflict reduces assessment confidence.
contradictions.REPUTATION_WEB_CONFLICT: A provider SAFE report conflicts with corroborated static credential-form and brand findings. This conflict reduces assessment confidence.
